title: trump_kim_short
question: Should Trump meet Kim again? Comment below

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump wants to meet Kim Jong Un *again*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Asked about a meeting on his Asia trip next month, he said *I may. That would be exciting*. I get along with him.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Kim's answer came the *same day*. Multiple *ballistic missiles*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: One flew more than *900 kilometers*. Japan says it may have been *hypersonic*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: It was the North's *fourth launch* in about a month.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The next day, Kim showed off the *Hwasong-20*, a missile built to *reach the United States*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: His wife and daughter were *right by his side*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump once said of Kim, *we fell in love*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: They've met *three times*. Singapore, Hanoi, the DMZ.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: *No deal* came out of any of them.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump heads to China in November. *No meeting* has been set.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Kim says he'll only talk if the U.S. *drops denuclearization*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Should Trump meet him again? *Tell us in the comments*.
